stages.description: Stages to run, in the order given. An entry is one of this repository's filters, or an object naming a script of the project's own. Defaults to the stack the filters depend on; the generator is not part of it, because it emits schema types into the project.

script.description: Node script to run at this point in the stack, relative to the project root — the same path a local filter definition would use.

name.description: Label for the log line. Defaults to the script's file name.

settings.description: Settings for this script, merged over `shared`.

shared.description: Settings merged into every stage. The addon's namespace belongs here; a stage that does not read a key ignores it.

stage.description: Settings for this stage, merged over `shared`. `false` skips the stage.
